# Woodstock Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Woodstock. Furnace repair covers diagnosis and correction of faults in gas-, propane-, and oil-fired furnaces, including ignition, airflow, burner, control, and venting problems.

Email: contact@woodstockheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://woodstockheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Woodstock, Ingersoll, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Thamesford, Embro. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
